ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC Ltd. announced a significant change in its senior management, appointing Mr. Rishi Awasthi as the new Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) effective October 1, 2026, replacing Mr. Basil Dange who resigned due to personal reasons. Mr. Awasthi brings over 14 years of extensive experience in information security and cyber risk, including a recent role at a group company, and possesses strong professional certifications, indicating a highly qualified successor for this critical position. The transition appears well-managed with no apparent red flags, suggesting continuity in the company's cybersecurity posture.
